name: Side-Lying Adductor Stretch
steps: Lie on one side on the floor with your bottom arm supporting your head and your bottom leg bent slightly forward for stability.
Raise your straight top leg and support it with your top hand at the calf or with a towel around the foot.
Draw your top leg gently closer toward your upper body until you feel a smooth stretch along the inner thigh.
Hold the stretch steadily with relaxed breaths on one side, then lower your leg gently and switch sides.
tips: Keep your hips stacked vertically rather than rolling backward onto your glutes.
Apply gentle, steady tension without bouncing your raised leg.
